source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
When you pick this unit to fight in the [Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase) or to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), you may Empower it by spending 1 [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain).

While it is Empowered, **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** of 1 may be re-rolled for its models' attacks. If the attack's target is in range of any objective marker, the whole [Wound roll](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) may be re-rolled instead.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.
